execution.numerical_analysis: Declared rented RunPod hosts only; imports NumPy/matplotlib only after pod and plan/source guards.

primary50.role: Primary budget-constrained safe-completion endpoint; earlier150-action ceiling is unchanged.

secondary30.role: Separately activated broader-training/shorter-endpoint study; never pooled with primary50 or chosen after final outcomes.

final_readiness: The joint opening and all SIX distinct selection locks,3@50 and3@30, must validate before ANY final state/outcome read. All final comparison/optional auxiliary protocols must be bound while every final output namespace is absent.

final_panel.no_source_case_or_outcome_exclusion: Require complete technically valid frozen final protocol/state panels. Incomplete/technical cases block efficacy analysis; preserve and account for every failed/partial attempt separately. No post-final replacement.

metrics.safe_completion: Original task completed within frozen horizon with no requested margin violation.
metrics.violation: Requested protected-body margin violation, from the frozen monitor; do not relabel as physical contact.
metrics.unfinished: Original task not completed; distinct from unsafe completion.
metrics.denominators: Per arm/repeat16 episodes and16 source-case clusters. Raw aggregate48 repeated observations across3 fixed controllers, not48 independent cases; per-host raw observations and repeat membership reported explicitly.

estimand: For each profile, equally average the three prespecified repeat/host-specific controller scores, then average over the16 source cases. Paired contrasts compare arms WITHIN the same source case,repeat and physical host before averaging repeats. Per-repeat and per-host summaries remain visible.

paired_contrasts.report: Mean difference in percentage points, conditional source-case percentile95 interval, all3 repeat differences, and physical-host blocks. No selection of favorable contrast/family/repeat after final outcomes.

bootstrap.unit: Source-case cluster; include ALL method/repeat/host observations for each resampled source case.
bootstrap.stratification: Within each fixed none/circle3/circle5/circle7 stratum, sample4 of its4 source cases WITH replacement independently; concatenate16 cluster indices.
bootstrap.pairing: Use the SAME10000 index draws for all arms,repeats,hosts,metrics and profiles; report profiles separately.

inference_scope: Conditional on the selected finite learned controllers, observed two physical hosts, fixed training/selection pipeline and within-room final case definition. Case bootstrap estimates source-case uncertainty only. It is NOT uncertainty over a population of future learners,optimizer seeds,training datasets or hosts. Three repeats remain visible and are not treated as independent source cases.
multiplicity: Four SC contrasts are prespecified. Intervals are descriptive conditional95percentile intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted family-wise inference; no p-values or post-final method selection. V/unfinished/engagement contrasts are supporting descriptors.
zero_violations: Zero observed violations is not zero risk. Case bootstrap can degenerate at zero. For each fixed controller,0/16 independent source cases gives an approximate3/16 upper bound under that assumption. Do not replace16 by48 correlated repeat observations.
selection_and_evolution_provenance: Report every selected_source_arm, declared/effective selected_is_trained, FP32 anchor-equivalence, native policies whose genes are ignored, producer run/candidate/generation/update and actual updates completed BEFORE that genotype was proposed/evaluated. Preserve all3 repeats; selecting an anchor/native-equivalent policy is not an evolutionary improvement. A generation0 winner is not credited with later CMA updates.

training_curves.x_axis: ACTUAL cumulative environment-action attempts in completed_job_ids order, including anchor, discarded/random candidates and both PG sampling and deterministic evaluation. Fixed-grid order follows its frozen job schedule.
training_curves.y_axis: Safe-completion rate of the lexicographically best COMPLETE deterministic training panel available by that action count. Tie retains the earlier/anchor incumbent. Full tuple/provenance also saved.
training_curves.panels: C/RS48 candidates plus anchor; PG24 paired sample/evaluation updates plus anchor; tuned-fixed48 distinct nonzero candidates plus anchor.
training_curves.landmarks: Frozen protocol quarters0,A/4,A/2,3A/4,A, using only already completed panels.
training_curves.unspent: Curves STOP at actual consumed actions; no line, carry-forward or estimate into unspent allowance. A landmark beyond used budget or before complete anchor has no estimate.
training_curves.scope: TRAIN learning curves are not final/generalization performance curves and never choose methods from final results.

resource_reporting: Report actual actions,hard allowance,unspent allowance,episode/planning time,encoder/cost/safety/readout attempted queries,predictor work and real optimizer updates separately by profile/repeat/arm/run. Keep counter units/aliases distinct. Common memory/readout/case preparation is separately costed by the campaign accounting collector, never charged once per reuse or counted from copied artifacts.

auxiliary_decoded_native.eligible_profiles: Only decoded-native endpoints30/50 already enabled in the jointly frozen final manifest BEFORE outcomes.
auxiliary_decoded_native.pairing: For each physical host and endpoint, compare its16 decoded-native cases to the native arm of that family's LOWEST repeat ID assigned to the host; fixed before outcomes.
auxiliary_decoded_native.outputs: Separate per-host counts/denominators, paired SC case-cluster differences and standalone figures/tables.

plot_design: Each profile gets SC/V/unfinished/engagement means with all3 fixed-repeat points, paired SC contrast intervals, and actual-action training incumbent plots. Auxiliary controls get separate host-block plots. Figure captions state the conditional case-cluster scope and zero-violation caveat.
analysis_input_contract: bind-inputs pins final manifest/protocol hashes, joint opening and both training manifests before final outputs exist. analyze requires every final state complete and source-bound, exact job/case/seed/weights, inner-episode artifact hashes, all16 shared source clusters and both complete3-repeat profiles.
amendment_rule: No modification of frozen source/plan after final outcomes. Any pre-outcome correction uses a new version preserving the previous bytes and reason.
